description: Return status for a tracked Playwright run. Pass runId for a specific background run, or omit it to inspect the latest tracked run for a workingDirectory. If no tracked run exists, returns idle with current results.json metadata; it does not inspect unrelated OS processes.

runId.description: Run identifier returned by run_tests with wait=false.

workingDirectory.description: Playwright project directory. Absolute or relative to the MCP server launch directory. Defaults to ".". Must be under PW_ALLOWED_DIRS. Used to find the latest tracked run when runId is omitted; when supplied with runId, it must resolve to that run working directory.

name: get_run_status
